title: Making an Appointment
context: Doctors, dentists, hairdressers and offices all work with appointments. You need to ask for a time, say what suits you, and change the plan politely when you cannot come.
contextPersian: پزشک، دندان‌پزشک، آرایشگر و ادارات همه با وقت قبلی کار می‌کنند. باید وقت بخواهی، بگویی چه زمانی برایت مناسب است و وقتی نمی‌توانی بیایی مؤدبانه برنامه را عوض کنی.

expressions.english: I'd like to make an appointment.
expressions.example: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Karimi.
expressions.examplePersian: سلام، می‌خواهم از دکتر کریمی وقت بگیرم.
expressions.note: I'd like to + verb is a polite way to say what you want.

expressions.english: Do you have anything available on Thursday?
expressions.example: Do you have anything available on Thursday afternoon?

expressions.persian: چه ساعتی برای شما مناسب است؟
expressions.example: What time suits you best? — Any time after four.
expressions.examplePersian: چه ساعتی برای شما مناسب‌تر است؟ — هر وقت بعد از چهار.

expressions.english: Is ten o'clock OK for you?
expressions.example: Is ten o'clock OK for you? — Yes, that's perfect.
expressions.examplePersian: ساعت ده برایتان خوب است؟ — بله، عالی است.

expressions.english: I'm afraid I can't make it on Monday.
expressions.example: I'm afraid I can't make it on Monday. I'm working all day.
expressions.examplePersian: متأسفانه دوشنبه نمی‌توانم بیایم. تمام روز سر کارم.
expressions.note: 'I'm afraid' softens bad news. 'Make it' means be able to come.

expressions.persian: می‌شود آن را به ... تغییر دهیم؟
expressions.example: Can we change it to Friday morning?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود آن را به جمعه صبح تغییر دهیم؟

expressions.english: I need to cancel my appointment.
expressions.example: I need to cancel my appointment for tomorrow. Something came up.
expressions.examplePersian: باید وقت فردایم را لغو کنم. کاری پیش آمده.
expressions.note: I need to + verb says it is necessary.

expressions.example: It's under the name Rezaei, at half past two.
expressions.examplePersian: به نام رضایی است، ساعت دو و نیم.

expressions.example: I have an appointment at nine with Dr. Karimi.
expressions.examplePersian: ساعت نه از دکتر کریمی وقت دارم.

expressions.example: How long will the appointment take? — About twenty minutes.
expressions.examplePersian: وقت چقدر طول می‌کشد؟ — حدود بیست دقیقه.

expressions.english: Could you confirm the time, please?
expressions.example: Could you confirm the time by email, please?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود ساعت را با ایمیل تأیید کنید؟

expressions.example: Thursday at four, then. See you then!
expressions.examplePersian: پس پنجشنبه ساعت چهار. آن موقع می‌بینمتان!

targets: I'd like to make an appointment.
exercises.prompt: You want to book a time with the dentist. You say:

targets: I'm afraid I can't make it on Monday.

exercises.explanationPersian: I'm afraid لحن خبر بد را نرم می‌کند.

speakingTask.instruction: Call to make an appointment, suggest a day, and then change it.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: با تلفن وقت بگیر، یک روز پیشنهاد بده و بعد آن را تغییر بده.
modelSentences: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment, please.
Do you have anything available on Thursday?
Is ten o'clock OK for you?
I'm afraid I can't make it. Can we change it to Friday?

roleplay.aiRole: A receptionist at a dental clinic
roleplay.learnerRole: A patient who wants an appointment
roleplay.objective: Book an appointment, then change it because something came up
roleplay.context: You are calling a dental clinic. Ask for an appointment this week, agree on a time and give your name. Then explain that you cannot come and ask to change it. Be polite, use I'd like to and I'm afraid.
roleplay.opening: Good morning, Smile Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
vocabulary: I'm afraid I can't make it
